name: Unstitched fabric, lawn and textile retail

problems.words: Than se gaz ke hisaab se bechte hain, roll mein kitna bacha pata nahi chalta
quick_ideas: Measure and tag your fastest-moving rolls once, so you know what's left on them
Note metres sold per roll for a week, so the tags stay roughly right.

workzap_build.text: a roll-level register with design, colour, metres in, sold and remaining, and alerts when a roll runs low.

problems.ask_first: Do you sell mostly pre-cut suits or by the metre?
problems.free_stops: How each roll is coded and sales are recorded at the counter is in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Compare the opening and closing length of a few busy rolls once, so missing gaz from rough cutting stands out.
Give one cutter the notebook for roll balance notes, so staff stop guessing what remains on each than.

problems.words: Cut pieces ka dher lag jaata hai
quick_ideas: Count and sort the cut-piece pile once by length, so you know what's actually sellable
Put the usable pieces on a visible rack, because hidden stock never sells.

workzap_build.text: cut pieces recorded per roll with a running list of sellable lengths and their value.

problems.ask_first: What happens to cut pieces today?
problems.free_stops: How cut pieces are captured and reported is in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Count how many cut pieces have been untouched since last week, so you see how much saleable cloth is lying idle.
Give one staff member the job of keeping all cut pieces in one marked spot, so usable stock gets shown sooner.

problems.words: Pichle season ka volume abhi bhi godown mein hai
quick_ideas: List leftover designs by volume and quantity once, so you know the real size of the problem
Offer them to wholesale buyers before the new season, so they don't age another year.

workzap_build.text: sell-through by design and volume by week of season, showing early which designs will be left over.

problems.ask_first: How much is left from last season?
problems.free_stops: How sell-through is tracked and when designs are flagged is in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Walk the godown and note which old designs appear in repeated piles, so the slowest season leftovers are clear.
Give one person the job of updating a single dead stock notebook, so old season volume stops getting overlooked.

problems.words: Printing unit har season launch late karta hai
quick_ideas: List every design with its printing due date in one place, so you see which part of the launch is at risk
Ask the printer for sampling approval dates, because delays usually start there.

workzap_build.text: a printing tracker: designs sent, sampling approved, metres ordered, received and colour-match result, with late alerts.

problems.free_stops: The stages and alert points are in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Note which designs are still waiting at the printing unit this week, so you see what is delaying the season launch.
Give one staff member the job of keeping all launch due notes in one notebook, so follow-up stays timely.

problems.words: Boutique wale credit pe lete hain aur mahino baad dete hain
quick_ideas: Add up what each wholesale buyer owes once, so you know who is oldest
Agree a credit limit with your biggest buyers, so balances don't keep growing.

workzap_build.text: a wholesale credit ledger per buyer code with ageing, limits and WhatsApp statements.

problems.ask_first: How many buyers take goods on credit?
problems.free_stops: How buyers are coded, limits enforced and statements sent is in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Count how many boutique parcels left on credit this week and how many old dues came back, so cash pressure for fresh stock shows.
Keep one notebook at the counter for every boutique balance and give one staff member the update duty, so follow-up stays clear at packing time.

problems.words: Har salesman alag rate deta hai
quick_ideas: Fix a price list for your top designs, so bargaining starts from the same number
Note the discounts given for a week, so you see how wide the range is.

workzap_build.text: a fixed price list on the counter tablet or POS with a salesman-wise discount log.

problems.ask_first: Are prices fixed or bargained today?
problems.free_stops: How prices are shown and discounts logged is in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Note the rate quoted for the same design by different salesmen once, so the size of rate variation shows.
Give one senior salesman the job of keeping the daily design rates in one notebook, so every counter starts alike.

problems.words: Salesmen ka commission kaagaz pe, hamesha jhagra
quick_ideas: Write the commission rule down once, so everyone agrees on the basis
Note the salesman on each sale for a week, so the total isn't argued later.

workzap_build.text: commission worked out from sales by salesman code, visible to each salesman.

problems.ask_first: How is commission worked out now?
problems.free_stops: How sales are tied to salesmen and commission calculated is in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Compare a few sales slips with the commission paper once, so the mismatch causing arguments becomes visible.
Give one person the job of writing the salesman name on every sale record, so commission totals are easier to settle.

problems.words: Online launch pe order stock se zyada ho jaate hain
quick_ideas: Count launch stock for online separately once, so the website sells only what's set aside
Hide sold-out designs by hand on launch day, so customers don't order what's gone.

workzap_build.text: an online catalogue sync that hides designs at zero stock across website and shop.

problems.free_stops: How shop and online stock are connected is in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Count how many launch orders could not be matched with set-aside stock once, so overselling on launch day is clear.
Give one person the job of maintaining one launch stock list, so order taking follows what is actually available.

problems.words: Bhaiyon ki doosri shops hain, numbers share nahi hote
quick_ideas: Agree on three numbers every shop shares weekly, so the family is looking at the same thing
Compare one week across shops, so the first conversation is about facts.

workzap_build.text: a shared morning read comparing each shop's sales and stock.

problems.free_stops: Which numbers each shop sees and how they're collected is in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Compare which numbers each shop actually shared this week once, so the missing branch updates are obvious.
Give one brother the job of writing all shops' weekly numbers in one notebook, so branch discussions stay on the same page.

never_say: How to sell replicas or use another brand's name.
Anything on export rebates, customs or invoicing.
Which side is right in a family partnership dispute.
That a launch or design will sell out.

sample_reply.person: Hum than se gaz ke hisaab se bechte hain, kabhi pata nahi chalta roll mein kitna bacha hai, aur cut pieces ka dher lagta rehta hai. Kya karein?
sample_reply.pi:
Ji, is ka rasta nikal sakta hai, aur is ke liye bade kharch ki zaroorat nahi.
Pehle, sab se zyada bikne wale rolls ko ek dafa naap ke tag kar dein, taa ke pata ho kitna bacha hai.
Doosra, cut pieces ka dher ek dafa lambai ke hisaab se chhaant lein aur kaam ke pieces saamne rack pe rakhein, kyunke chhupa hua maal nahi bikta.
Is ke baad Workzap ye bana sakta hai: har roll ka register jis mein metres andar, bike aur baaki dikhein, cut pieces ka record, aur roll khatam hone se pehle alert.
